analysis:
Only docs/architecture/inference.md changed, and only base-side text was supplied. The visible patch excerpt is truncated after the first hunks. Visible changes are the "Last updated" date bump (line 3) and an edited EngineV2SlotFactory table row (line 61). The row now adds a phrase about refusing an ordinary fixed-workspace bridge with zero serving width before publication. That wording already appears in the base text, so the change looks like a rewording, not a new control. The file_changes ranges show further head-side edits at roughly lines 71-310, 902-910, 928, 939-959, 1225-1250 and 1498-1505. Those head lines were not supplied, so I could not review them. The base text for those regions covers workspace-aware KV floors, calibration, deadline admission, MTP, prefix cache and media caps.

A documentation change alters no code, keys, endpoints or authorization, and I found no regression. Relevant threat IDs for the surrounding text are T-041 (prefix-cache TTFT oracle and SSD at-rest), T-027, T-028 and T-029 (TB-007 weights, residual GPU data, idle timeout), and T-010 (cancellation). Doc statements about retirement-gated KV reservation, the prefix cache and the "no persistent KV carve" posture should stay consistent with T-041 and TB-007. The next pass should check the head-side hunks for new claims that loosen or contradict those mitigations. These include the TTL, disk-budget and per-donation gating, SEC-035 acceptance, cache salt scoping, and any wording that overclaims correctness or secrecy. No unsupported finding was raised.
